findings.title: Privileged container
findings.remediation: Remove privileged mode and grant only narrowly scoped Linux capabilities if required.

findings.title: runAsNonRoot not enforced
findings.message: The container does not explicitly enforce a non-root runtime user.
findings.remediation: Set securityContext.runAsNonRoot=true and use an image with a non-root user.

findings.title: Privilege escalation not disabled
findings.remediation: Set securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation=false unless a documented exception exists.

findings.title: Resource requests/limits incomplete
findings.message: Container does not define both resource requests and limits.
findings.remediation: Set CPU and memory requests/limits based on measured workload behavior.
